title: Ancient of Days

bible_verses.english: I watched until thrones were placed, and an ancient of days sat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of his head was like pure wool. His throne was fiery flames, and its wheels burning fire.
Your throne is established from of old. You are from everlasting.

God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Therefore we will not fear, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas; though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, my Ancient of Days, thank You for being my unshakeable refuge when the world around me feels uncertain. Remind me today that You hold all of time and history safely in Your hands. When fear tries to creep into my heart, help me to fix my gaze on Your eternal throne and rest in Your sovereign love. You are above all things, and I place my trust completely in You. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: In a world that often feels unstable and chaotic, "Ancient of Days" reminds us where our true security lies. Kingdoms and circumstances may shift overnight, but Jesus remains securely on His throne, holding all of time in His hands. When we fix our eyes on His eternal reign, fear loses its power and peace takes its place. Today, let this truth anchor your heart: the One who holds the universe is the very same God who lovingly holds you.
